Long, straight, jet-black hair with sharp hime-cut bangs. Sharp, focused, ruby-red eyes. Appears in the late 30s with a cold, mature gaze. Lean and athletic build. Wears a traditional red kimono-style wrap with black leggings and a high-collared red cloak. Includes a red fabric mask covering the lower half of the face.
